summary: Held the entire episode -- never saw a wrong-direction signature. After an early 4-9min dip near breakeven (normal early chop), the trade broke out hard, running from roughly +5 to a peak of +52pts by t=23m, then gave back a large chunk in two waves (52->15, then a bounce to 30, then back to 20) but never approached breakeven again, let alone went negative. The pullbacks always showed partial recovery (HA/PROPP flipping back with, 1m bars closing off their lows) rather than a clean, sustained break of structure, so there was never a point where the entry thesis looked falsified. Next time I'd watch for a pullback that closes below prior swing lows on the 1m/5m AND fails to reclaim on the next bar -- that combo, not just giveback%, is what would flag a genuine reversal worth bailing on.
